faq.a1: No. It only sees the text you copied or selected. It has no access to messengers.
faq.a2: No. The server holds the text in memory for one request and then forgets it.
faq.a3: The system is tuned to write natural Kazakh rather than translate from Russian.
faq.a4: Every night in the server's timezone. Changing the clock on the phone does not affect it.
faq.a5: No, generating a reply needs a connection. Without one the keyboard still types normally.
faq.a6: Only the account and usage counters: phone or email, plan, daily counter. Not conversations.
faq.q1: Does AI Reply read my conversations?
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
features.f1.body: Client, colleague, friend, partner — each with its own tone and rules.
features.f1.title: Relationship templates
features.f2.body: Describe what you sell once — replies lean on that and never invent prices.
features.f2.title: Business context
features.f3.body: When you answer at night, it knows when you are back online.
features.f3.title: Working hours
features.f4.body: The interface language does not change the reply: it always matches the incoming message.
features.f4.title: It answers in their language
features.f5.body: Save the replies you repeat and use them in one tap.
features.f5.title: Saved templates
features.f6.body: How many replies you have left today shows in the app and in the keyboard.
features.f6.title: Your limit is always visible
features.title: Features
hero.demo2_incoming: Can we move tomorrow's meeting to 10?
hero.demo2_reply: Sure, let's move it. How about 11? That works better for me.
hero.demo3_incoming: When will my order arrive? It's been two days
hero.demo3_instruction: Apologise, say I will check today and reply
hero.demo3_reply: Sorry for the wait. I'll check the order status today and send you the exact date.
hero.demo_incoming: Hello! How much is delivery and when can you bring it?
hero.demo_instruction: Reply politely, say I will check the price and come back
hero.demo_reply: Hello! Let me check the delivery cost and I will get back to you in a couple of minutes. Which area do you need it in?
hero.note: The free plan gives 7 replies a day. No card needed.
hero.subtitle: Copy the message you received, say in one sentence what to answer — AI Reply writes the reply in your own voice. All of it in a keyboard, on top of any messenger.
hero.title: Get back the time you spend writing replies
how.step1.body: WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram — select the text in any app and tap Copy.
how.step1.title: Copy the message
how.step2.body: The keyboard reads what you copied. Nothing else is accessed.
how.step2.title: Switch to the AI Reply keyboard
how.step3.body: "Decline politely", "Keep it short", "Say I am busy" — type it, or dictate it on Android.
how.step3.title: Give an instruction
how.step4.body: Read the draft, edit it if you like, and send it yourself. Nothing is ever sent automatically.
how.step4.title: Insert the reply
how.subtitle: Four steps, without leaving the messenger.
how.title: How it works
keyboard.body: AI Reply is a keyboard extension on iOS and an IME on Android. It replaces the system keyboard, so it works on top of any messenger.
keyboard.title: Your own keyboard
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.terms.title: Public offer
pricing.note: Limits are enforced on the server and changed from the admin panel — no app release needed.
pricing.subtitle: Start free. If the limit is not enough, change the plan any time.
pricing.title: Pricing
privacy.note: AI Reply does not read your conversations in other messengers by itself. The operating system does not allow that, and we do not claim otherwise: the keyboard only sees the text you copied.
privacy.p1.body: Neither the copied message nor the generated reply is written to the database. There is no column for it.
privacy.p1.title: Conversations are not stored
privacy.p2.body: The admin panel has no "view conversations" screen, because there is nothing to show.
privacy.p2.title: Administrators cannot read them
privacy.p3.body: Logs hold metadata only: time, duration, token counts, error code.
privacy.p3.title: Logs carry no text
privacy.p4.body: No contact list, no location, no advertising identifier.
privacy.p4.title: No extra data is collected
privacy.subtitle: Writing a reply needs the text on the server. It is not stored there.
privacy.title: Privacy is in the architecture, not in a promise
stats.title: In numbers
value.item1.body: A customer will not wait ten minutes. The faster the reply, the more often the deal closes.
value.item1.title: Sales move faster
value.item2.body: Even at the end of a long day the reply stays polite and to the point.
value.item2.title: One consistent tone
value.item3.body: A Kazakh message gets a Kazakh reply, a Russian one gets Russian.
value.item3.title: Fluent in your languages
value.subtitle: Dozens of messages a day, the same questions, two or three minutes on every answer.
value.title: Why it exists
voice.body: You do not have to type the instruction: tap the microphone and say what to answer. The microphone is used for your instruction only.
voice.title: Voice on Android
